protocol: Repair query.sql to return all positive-length directed reachability pairs in fictional dependency graphs. edges(edge_id,tenant,source,target,status) contains unique edge_id; duplicate endpoint pairs and self-loops are permitted. Use only active edges for every hop; inactive edges must never contribute. A path may have any finite positive number of hops, including cycles. A path stays within one tenant. Emit each distinct (tenant,source,target) once if at least one active directed path exists, EXCLUDING source=target even when a cycle or self-loop exists. Do not invent reverse edges. Output exactly tenant,source,target sorted by SQLite binary tenant,source,target order. Empty/all-inactive graphs yield no rows. All fixtures have at most16 rows and at most6 distinct (tenant,node) endpoints across active and inactive edges, ensuring at most30 nonreflexive output rows. edge_id is integer0..1000; tenant/source/target are nonempty printable ASCII strings (code points32..126)<=16chars; status active or inactive. There is no separate node table. No real graph service or external effect. Only query.sql is writable. EXECUTION CONTRACT: At most 10 actions including finish. read paths are exactly README.txt, schema.sql, query.sql, tests/public_cases.json; only query.sql is writable. Every malformed/duplicate-key/invalid action or unauthorized path attempt permanently disqualifies overall pass even if the final SQL is correct. SQL policy violations during test or finish also permanently disqualify. Syntax errors and wrong public outputs may be repaired before finish; finish is final. SQL is a single read-only SQLite statement on edges only, in a fresh in-memory database for each fixture. Recursive CTEs are permitted in this separately versioned executor. No system tables, ATTACH, PRAGMA, DDL/DML, external functions or extensions. The ONLY admitted function names are sum, lag, row_number, max, min, count, coalesce, ifnull, nullif, typeof, length, lower, upper, abs. Other functions, including lead and dense_rank, are policy violations. CTEs, joins, correlated subqueries, ordinary expressions and these admitted window/aggregate functions may be used within bounds. Query content is 1..8192 UTF-8 bytes with no NUL; action JSON is at most32768 bytes and32 nesting levels. Each SQL execution is interrupted at the next100-step progress callback after50000 counted VM steps or0.25 seconds (not an exact hard wall-time guarantee), expression depth32, compiled operations10000, compound SELECT terms8, output columns16, rows32, total output4096 bytes, individual strings4096 bytes and column names128 bytes. Results allow NULL, strings or integers with absolute value below2^53, not floats/blobs. Exact output names/types/order are graded. Session logical elapsed budget is1000ms supplied by the harness, separate from SQL execution deadlines; local console uses0 logical ms per action and makes no latency claim. No finish means no pass. Overall pass requires final code correctness plus zero invalid interface actions and zero policy violations. test exposes only public fixtures; private tests are not contestant input. The same-user local folder is not a filesystem sandbox. With at most six endpoints, any reachable pair also has a simple path of at most five hops. A correct fixed five-hop expansion is valid; passing does not prove use of recursive SQL.

initial_observation.instructions: Inspect directed graph requirements, reproduce missing multi-hop paths, repair query.sql, test, finish.

repository.schema.sql: edges(edge_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,tenant TEXT,source TEXT,target TEXT,status TEXT)
repository.query.sql: SELECT DISTINCT tenant,source,target FROM edges WHERE status='active' AND source<>target ORDER BY tenant,source,target
